entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5, VizieR J/ApJ/830/10/table5 row Gal = N4424, ID = 50324: J2000 position; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Riess et al. (2016), ApJ 826, 56, table 5: NGC 4424's Cepheid distance modulus 31.08 +/- 0.292 mag, 10^(mu/5 + 1) pc (https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.01424): 16443717 +/- 2211203 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: J/ApJ/830/10/table5 row Gal = N4424, ID = 50324 measures no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 16,443,717 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 77,951 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity of NGC 4424, the Cepheid's galaxy, from 2022ApJS..261...21Y; the star's own motion within the galaxy is not measured.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 92.9 +/- 15.5 solar radii from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 16.88 d in Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5; not a measurement of this star: eq. 2, log R = 0.721 log P + 1.083; the uncertainty is the relation's scatter, 0.067 dex (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5150 +/- 317 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, period relations for Galactic fundamental-mode Cepheids applied to this star's period, 16.88 d in Hoffmann et al. (2016), ApJ 830, 10, table 5; not a measurement of this star: the luminosity of eq. 1 (M_bol = -2.95 log P - 0.98, with the nominal solar M_bol 4.74) over the radius of eq. 2, through L = 4 pi R^2 sigma T^4 with the nominal solar 5772 K (IAU 2015 Resolutions B2 (Mamajek et al. 2015, arXiv:1510.06262) and B3 (Prsa et al. 2016, arXiv:1605.09788)); the uncertainty is the 317 K by which the two relations miss the paper's own temperatures of its Cepheids.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,150 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: the star has no Gaia DR3 source; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe8d5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: the star has no Gaia DR3 source; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,150 K and log g 0.85 (u1 0.585, u2 0.160): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Unmeasured, bounded: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 1.9% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 0.85, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 0.85 is a display choice, not a measurement.
